localized.zh_cn: 恒常日月之盐已修正：切换昼夜保留累计日期，不再退回世界第一天。
localized.en_us: Salis Aevus now preserves the world’s accumulated days instead of resetting the calendar to day one.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘分解杵已修正：充能不足时不再扣成负数；支持现代耕地规则，并可从佩戴的储魔饰品和副手法杖充能。
localized.en_us: The Thaumic Disassembler cannot spend charge below zero. It supports modern tilling rules and charges from worn vis accessories or an offhand wand.

localized.zh_cn: 蓄力斩已修正：伤害、距离和蓄力时间统一核验，不再接受任意目标或伤害。
localized.en_us: Charged strikes now validate damage, range and charge time, rejecting arbitrary targets or damage.

localized.zh_cn: 飞天魔符已修正：改名后仍可提供飞行能力。
localized.en_us: Renamed Flyte Charms still grant flight.

localized.zh_cn: 污秽魔法面具配方已扩展：虚空与暗影要塞头盔的狞笑恶鬼面具可使用任意黑色染料。
localized.en_us: Tainted Magic mask recipes accept any black dye for Grinning Devil faceplates on Void and Shadow Fortress helms.

localized.zh_cn: 护甲结算适配新版：可与本体及其他扩展的特殊护甲混穿，各部件共同结算防护和耐久。
localized.en_us: Armour protection supports mixed sets: each piece contributes alongside Thaumcraft and other addons’ special armour.
